We therefore formulate Agentic Speech Recognition (AgenticSR), an audio-to-clean-text task that removes disfluencies, resolves self-corrections, and normalizes written form while preserving the speaker's final intent. AgenticASR implements this task through an ASR--Refiner architecture that repeatedly transforms a bounded active context and replaces its corresponding output span as audio arrives. This enables continual emission and revision over streams of arbitrary duration. We also introduce AASR-Bench, a bilingual benchmark with fine-grained atomic rubrics. Across multiple ASR front ends, AgenticASR attains the highest AASR-Bench scores among evaluated systems. A human--AI agreement study shows that rubric-based judgments align with independent expert assessments. Ablations characterize Refiner capacity, context length, and the quality--latency trade-off between online and offline inference. Together, these results establish AgenticASR as a practical framework for intent-preserving clean transcription during ongoing speech. Code, AASR-Bench, and a demo will be released at https://github.com/AnXMuy/AgenticASR.

</details>


### [264] [Old Tricks, New Models: How Simple Image Transformations Break Modern AI-based Content Moderation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28187)
*Marco Alecci,Francesco Marchiori,Iyiola Emmanuel Olatunji,Tegawendé F. Bissyandé,Jacques Klein*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 对三种商业图片审核API进行黑盒测试，发现使用简单的图像变换即可绕过其安全过滤，表明基于基础模型的审核系统并非可靠的安全边界，应作为多层审核流水线的一部分而非独立使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的任务特定分类器在政策覆盖和上下文理解方面有限，而基于大型基础模型的多模态审核API承诺提供更广泛和更强大的安全过滤，但尚不清楚这一转变是否带来了更鲁棒的图片审核能力。

Method: 对三种成熟的商业图片审核服务进行大规模黑盒评估，使用七种简单、模型无关的图像变换，跨多个提供商、数据集、危害类别、感知相似性约束和变换强度进行测试。

Result: 所有三种商业服务均可被廉价图像变换绕过，无需梯度、替代模型或目标系统知识；固定变换如颜色反转和灰度转换可导致安全决策从有害变为安全，而内容仍可被人类识别；鲁棒性在不同数据集和危害类别间差异显著，多模态内容和自伤类别尤为脆弱。

Conclusion: 用基础模型API替换传统审核分类器本身并不能提供可靠的安全边界，此类系统必须在真实变换下进行评估，并作为分层审核流水线的一个组件而非独立安全过滤器来部署。

Abstract: While automated content-moderation systems have become essential for screening harmful content at scale, conventional task-specific classifiers often provide limited policy cov- erage and contextual understanding. Recently, commercial multimodal moderation APIs built on large foundation models have been introduced with the promise of providing broader and more capable safety filters. In this work, we analyze whether this shift also yields more robust image moderation. We conduct a large-scale black-box evaluation on three established commercial image-moderation services and compare their robustness. By evaluating seven simple, model-agnostic image transformations across multiple providers, datasets, harm categories, perceptual-similarity constraints, and transformation intensities, we find that: (1) all three commercial services can be bypassed using inexpensive image transformations that require no gradients, surrogate models, or knowledge of the target system; (2) even fixed transformations such as color inversion and grayscale conversion induce unsafe-to-safe decision changes while preserving content that remains recognizable to humans; (3) their robustness varies substantially across datasets and harm categories, with multimodal content and self-harm exhibiting pronounced vulnerabilities. This yields the conclusion that replacing conventional moderation classifiers with foundation-model-based APIs does not, by itself, provide a reliable security boundary. Such systems must be evaluated under realistic transformations and deployed as one component of a layered moderation pipeline rather than as standalone safety filters.

</details>


### [265] [Qwen-UI-Agent Technical Report: Toward Next-Generation Real-World Centric Foundation GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28227)
*Hanzhang Zhou,Panrong Tong,Xu Zhang,Quyu Kong,Chenglin Cai,Tianyu Xia,Gongjie Zhang,Jianan Zhang,Long Li,Long Chen,Lei Wang,Gaole Dai,Pengxiang Li,Liangyu Chen,Yue Wang,Steven Hoi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Qwen-UI-Agent is a real-world centric foundation GUI agent that spans mobile, computer-use, web, and DeepSearch environments. It combines diverse sandbox environments with a large-scale real-device mobile runtime, uses a unified action space interleaving GUI and CLI operations, an AutoResearch-style data flywheel for iterative improvement, online RL with long trajectories and massive concurrent environments, and a lightweight harness for proactive services. It achieves state-of-the-art on mobile benchmarks and competitive performance on computer/browser tasks against frontier models like Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and GPT-5.6 Sol.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GUI agents have potential as general-purpose executors over digital devices, but current agents lack reliability on real devices, cross-platform workflow execution, integration of GUI and CLI, long-horizon task completion, proactive service initiation, and autonomous improvement with minimal human effort. This work aims to advance GUI agents toward real-world use by addressing all these challenges.

Method: Qwen-UI-Agent uses a unified architecture with: (1) diverse sandbox environments plus a large-scale real-device mobile runtime; (2) a unified action space that interleaves GUI operations with CLI execution and generates batched actions per model turn; (3) an AutoResearch-style data flywheel where agents construct tasks/environments, diagnose failures, and plan iterations; (4) online RL training on trajectories exceeding 100 turns with over 10,000 concurrent environments; (5) a lightweight harness layer for proactive service initiation and stateful workflows across mobile and computer.

Result: On mobile benchmarks: 82.1% on MobileWorld, 92.2% on MobileWorld-Real, 97.5% on AndroidDaily. On computer use: 79.5% on OSWorld-Verified, 40.0% partial-progress on OSWorld-v2. On browser/GUI grounding: 73.6% on WebArena, 81.5% on ScreenSpot-Pro. Sets state-of-the-art on mobile-use and competitive performance against frontier models.

Conclusion: Qwen-UI-Agent demonstrates that a real-world centric design combining sandbox and real-device training, unified action space, automated data flywheel, and large-scale distributed RL enables powerful GUI agents that can operate across mobile, computer, and web environments with strong performance and autonomous improvement capabilities.

Abstract: GUI agents have the potential to become a general purpose executor over existing digital devices. To advance them toward real-world use, we envision agents that operate reliably on real devices, execute workflows across platforms, combine GUI interaction with CLI execution, complete long-horizon tasks, proactively initiate useful services, and autonomously improve their capabilities with minimal human effort. Guided by this vision, we present Qwen-UI-Agent, a real-world centric foundation GUI agent spanning mobile, computer-use, web, and DeepSearch environments. Qwen-UI-Agent combines diverse sandbox environments with a large-scale real-device mobile runtime. Its unified action space interleaves GUI operations with CLI execution and generates batched actions in a single model turn. An AutoResearch-style data flywheel uses agents to construct tasks and environments, diagnose failures, and plan subsequent iterations. Online RL supports training on trajectories exceeding 100 turns, with over 10,000 concurrent environments accelerating rollout. A lightweight harness layer supports proactive service initiation and stateful workflows across mobile and computer.
  Across a broad suite of evaluations, Qwen-UI-Agent sets state-of-the-art performance on mobile-use benchmarks while delivering competitive performance on computer- and browser-use tasks against frontier models, including Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and GPT-5.6 Sol. On mobile use, it achieves 82.1% on MobileWorld, 92.2% on MobileWorld-Real, and 97.5% on AndroidDaily. On computer use, it achieves 79.5% on OSWorld-Verified and a 40.0% partial-progress score on OSWorld-v2. On browser use and GUI grounding, it achieves 73.6% on WebArena and 81.5% on ScreenSpot-Pro, respectively.

</details>


### [266] [OSReward: Instituting Standardized Evaluation for Cross-Platform Computer-Use Reward Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28609)
*Qiushi Sun,Kanzhi Cheng,Yian Wang,Bowen Yang,Hang Yan,Liheng Chen,Fangzhi Xu,Zichen Ding,Nuo Chen,Jialin Cao,Xingdong Gong,Zehao Li,Kaiming Jin,Xinfeng Yuan,Zhoumianze Liu,Jingyang Gong,Zhangyue Yin,Jiahui Gao,Zhiyong Wu,Tianbao Xie,Jianbing Zhang,Ben Kao,Lingpeng Kong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了OSReward基准，用于评估视觉语言模型作为CUA轨迹评判者的可靠性；发现现有模型存在系统性宽大偏差，并训练了OS-Shepherd奖励模型以提供低成本的可靠信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CUA轨迹验证是评估、数据整理和强化学习的核心，但人工或基于规则的验证无法规模化，因此转向VLM作为评判者。然而，这些VLM评判者的可靠性从未被系统研究过。

Method: 构建了OSReward基准（包含多平台、多智能体的CUA轨迹及其人工标注的真实标签），衍生出OSReward-Hard（困难样本）和OSReward-Multi（细粒度评分），并基于此评估了多种VLM评判者；进一步构建了OS-Shepherd-100K语料库，训练了OS-Shepherd (9B/35B)奖励模型。

Result: 最先进的VLM评判者远未达到理想标准，存在系统性宽大偏差（将失败轨迹误判为成功）；少数可靠的模型成本过高，而开源模型性能落后；OS-Shepherd以30-60%更低成本达到商业模型的性能。

Conclusion: VLM评判者可靠性不足，但OS-Shepherd提供了低成本、稳定、可靠的替代方案；相关工作已开源。

Abstract: Computer-using agents (CUAs) are advancing rapidly across the digital world. A CUA trajectory records the agent's actions, states, and reasoning. Verifying whether it fulfilled the task instruction is central to CUA evaluation, data curation, and reinforcement learning. Neither human-written verifiers nor human annotators can provide such verification at scale, so the field increasingly turns to vision-language models (VLMs) as judges of CUA trajectories. But a fundamental question has long gone unexamined: are these VLM judges reliable enough? To study it systematically, we introduce OSReward, a realistic, high-quality benchmark that evaluates VLM judges on CUA trajectories. The trajectories come from diverse agent backbones executing human-verified instructions across platforms, then rigorously labeled with ground-truth verdicts through multi-stage human annotation. Building on it, we derive OSReward-Hard, a challenge set concentrating genuinely hard cases, and OSReward-Multi for fine-grained efficiency and alignment scoring. The most comprehensive evaluation of VLM judges to date finds even state-of-the-art models fall short of an ideal judge, sharing a systematic leniency bias that mislabels failed runs as successes. The few reliable enough to trust are too expensive to run at scale, while affordable open models trail far behind. To close this gap, we construct and release OS-Shepherd-100K, an open corpus of reasoning-annotated trajectory judgments for the CUA community. On it, we train OS-Shepherd (9B and 35B), open reward models that supply low-cost, stable, and reliable reward signals, matching commercial judges at 30-60% lower cost than the frontier. Extensive analyses further inform the design of reliable CUA reward at scale. Our code, benchmark, dataset, and model checkpoints are available at https://os-copilot.github.io/OSReward-Home/.

</details>


### [267] [AISPA: User-Centric System Prompt Auditing for Large Language Model Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28617)
*Xiangning Lin,Shenzhe Zhu,Shu Yang,Zhenyu Zhang,Haoqian Zhang,Yipeng Zhao,Chengxuan Qian,Tianwei Wang,Ziheng Zhang,Zhenlong Yuan,Dingcheng Wang,Juncheng Wu,Yuan Si,Jiaxin Liu,Baolong Bi,Robert Mahari,Tobin South,Dazza Greenwood,Zexue He,Rishi Bommasani,Sophia Kazinnik,Andreas Haupt,Samuele Marro,Erik Brynjolfsson,Alex Pentland,Jiaxin Pei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出AISPA框架，用于审计商业AI产品中的系统提示词。通过对88个商业AI产品的3,249条指令进行审计，发现系统提示词设计差异大、保护性指令虽普及但深度不足、提示词长度和用户保护性持续增长，但仍有约40%产品包含损害用户利益的指令，揭示了透明度、标准化和独立监督的必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 系统提示词在商业AI产品中被广泛使用，但极少公开披露，导致信任与问责缺口。现有缺乏系统性审计框架来评估系统提示词对用户的影响。

Method: 提出AISPA（人工智能系统提示词保证）框架，从八个用户关心维度对系统提示词进行分类审计。采用该框架对88个商业AI产品的3,249条指令进行审查，将每条指令归类为保护性（对用户有利）或问题性（对用户不利）。

Result: 四大发现：（1）系统提示词设计在产品间差异巨大；（2）保护性指令虽普及（98.9%产品至少包含一条）但覆盖深度不足（仅24%覆盖所有八个维度）；（3）系统提示词长度和用户保护性持续增长；（4）问题性指令仍然普遍（约40%产品包含至少一条），且保护性与问题性指令常共存于同一提示词中。

Conclusion: 商业AI产品的系统提示词亟需更高的透明度、标准化和独立监督，以弥合信任与问责缺口。

Abstract: System prompts are instructions configured by developers to govern the behaviors of foundation models in AI applications. They are used throughout commercial AI products, but are rarely disclosed to the public or regulators, creating a serious trust and accountability gap in the wide deployment of AI systems. In this paper, we introduce Artificial Intelligence System Prompt Assurance (AISPA), a user-centric framework for systematically auditing system prompts in AI systems. AISPA examines specific parts of a system prompt and evaluates them along eight dimensions that matter to users. We then use this framework to review 3,249 instructions from system prompts in 88 commercial AI products, classifying each instruction as either protective (of users) or problematic. Our audit surfaces four core findings. First, system prompt design varies substantially across products and developers, with some organizations averaging over 60 protective instructions per product while others average fewer than 5. Second, protective instructions are widely adopted but shallow in scope: 98.9% of products contain at least one, yet only 24% cover all eight dimensions of the AISPA taxonomy. Third, system prompts have grown steadily longer and more protective of users, suggesting that user protection is becoming a more visible concern in commercial prompt design. Fourth, despite this progress, problematic instructions remain pervasive: roughly 40% of products contain at least one instruction that works against user interests, and protective and problematic instructions frequently coexist within the same prompt. Our findings highlight the need for greater transparency, standardization, and independent oversight for system prompts in commercial AI products.

</details>


### [268] [AI and Authenticity in Islamic Research: A Critical Evaluation of Generative AI Reliability, Hallucination, and Source Fidelity in Quranic, Hadith, and Fiqh Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28237)
*Muhammad Sajjad Akbar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究评估了六种主流生成式AI系统在伊斯兰知识领域的表现，通过50个开放式问题涵盖《古兰经》解释、圣训、教法、伦理、 pastoral建议和教法学派敏感主题。采用混合方法分析领域准确性、引文验证、幻觉、教法一致性、不确定性处理、来源出处和地理差异。结论：当前AI可作为入门伊斯兰学习的辅助工具，但不能替代权威学术来源用于宗教裁决或学术研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管生成式AI在伊斯兰宗教指导中的应用日益广泛，但缺乏对其提供真实、可验证、可信赖的伊斯兰知识能力的实证证据。本研究旨在填补这一空白，评估AI在高信任宗教语境下的可靠性。

Method: 选取六种领先的生成式AI系统，使用50个涵盖《古兰经》解释、圣训、教法、伦理、牧灵建议和教法学派敏感话题的现实开放式伊斯兰问题。在澳大利亚和英国的真实条件下收集回答，采用混合方法框架分析领域准确性、引文验证、幻觉、教法一致性、不确定性处理、来源出处和地理差异。

Result: 当前生成式AI系统在伊斯兰知识各主要领域的准确性和真实性参差不齐；存在幻觉、不完整引文或不可验证的宗教引用；模型在处理教法分歧、教法学派多样性和不确定性时一致性不足；整体上不适合作为宗教裁决或学术研究的权威来源。

Conclusion: 生成式AI可作为伊斯兰入门学习的辅助工具，但不应被视为宗教裁决或伊斯兰研究的权威来源，使用前必须经过权威原始资料和合格学者专业知识的验证。本研究提供了首批全面的实证评估，为研究人员、教育者、AI开发者和穆斯林社区提供实践指导。

Abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) is increasingly used by Muslims for religious guidance, Qur'anic interpretation, Hadith explanation, jurisprudential rulings, and Islamic education. Despite its growing adoption, there is limited empirical evidence on whether current AI systems provide authentic, verifiable, and trustworthy Islamic knowledge suitable for high-trust religious contexts. This study evaluates six leading generative AI systems using fifty realistic open-ended Islamic questions covering Qur'anic interpretation, Hadith, Fiqh, ethics, pastoral advice, and Madhhab-sensitive topics. Responses were collected under real-world conditions from participants in Australia and the United Kingdom and analysed using a mixed-method framework examining domain accuracy, citation verification, hallucinations, jurisprudential consistency, uncertainty handling, source provenance, and geographical variation.
  The study addresses four research questions: (1) How accurate and authentic are AI-generated responses across major Islamic knowledge domains? (2) To what extent do AI systems produce hallucinations, incomplete citations, or unverifiable religious references? (3) How consistently do models handle jurisprudential disagreement, Madhhab diversity, and uncertainty? (4) Are current AI systems sufficiently reliable for religious guidance, Islamic education, and scholarly research?
  Overall, current generative AI systems are valuable as assistive tools for introductory Islamic learning but should not be treated as authoritative sources for religious rulings or Islamic research without verification against authenticated primary sources and qualified scholarly expertise. This study provides one of the first comprehensive empirical evaluations of AI reliability within Islamic knowledge, offering practical guidance for researchers, educators, AI developers, and the wider Muslim community.

</details>


### [269] [Operationally Guided Placement-Aware Learning for Industrial Online 3D Bin Packing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28257)
*Dheeraj Poolavaram,Aanchal Rajesh Chugh,Sebastian Dorn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: OPAL is a learning framework for online 3D bin packing that uses an operationally guided candidate generator (OG-EMS) and a placement encoder (xLSTM) combined with a masked ranking policy trained via PPO, achieving 0.49 space utilization on BED-BPP benchmark with 15.1% improvement from guided generation and 6.3% from learned ranking.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Prior learning-based methods for online 3D-BPP mainly optimized the policy while candidate generation and representation remained largely geometry-driven, neglecting operational requirements like stability, compactness, and balance. This paper aims to address that gap by incorporating operational guidance into candidate generation and representation.

Method: The method combines three components: (1) Operationally Guided Empty-Maximal-Space generator (OG-EMS) that evaluates multiple anchors within free-space regions and prioritizes low, well-supported, compact, and spatially diverse placements; (2) an operational representation for each candidate placement; (3) a masked ranking policy trained with PPO, using an xLSTM-based Placement Encoder to model dependencies among geometric and operational attributes, and a lightweight recurrent core to combine embeddings with item and pallet state for ranking.

Result: On the BED-BPP benchmark, OPAL achieves a mean space utilization of 0.49, with improvements of 15.1% from operationally guided candidate generation and 6.3% from learned ranking, while maintaining robust inference-time performance.

Conclusion: The paper demonstrates that incorporating operational guidance into candidate generation and representation significantly improves space utilization in online 3D-BPP, highlighting the importance of these components beyond just policy optimization.

Abstract: The online three-dimensional bin packing problem (3D-BPP) is a longstanding challenge in logistics and industrial palletizing. Recent learning-based methods use a learned policy to select among feasible candidate placements. Performance depends on the candidate generator and representation, especially in industrial settings where packings must be space-efficient, stable, compact, and balanced. However, prior work has mainly optimized the policy, while candidate generation and representation remain largely geometry-driven. We address this gap with OPAL, an operationally guided placement-aware learning framework for industrial online 3D-BPP which combines an Operationally Guided Empty-Maximal-Space generator (OG-EMS), an operational representation for each candidate placement, and a masked ranking policy trained with proximal policy optimization. OG-EMS evaluates multiple anchors within each free-space region and prioritizes low, well-supported, compact, and spatially diverse placements. An xLSTM-based Placement Encoder models dependencies among geometric and operational candidate attributes, while a lightweight recurrent core combines the resulting embeddings with the current item and pallet state to rank feasible actions. On the BED-BPP benchmark, OPAL achieves a mean space utilization of 0.49, with improvements of 15.1% from operationally guided candidate generation and 6.3% from learned ranking, while maintaining robust inference-time performance.

</details>


### [270] [LLM-Guided Evolutionary Search for Constraint Model Reformulation to Improve Solver Efficiency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28268)
*Kostis Michailidis,Dimos Tsouros,Nguyen Dang,Tias Guns*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究如何利用大型语言模型（LLM）自动对约束模型进行面向性能的重构。受自动启发式设计启发，采用演化框架，由LLM提出候选重构，经验证和基准测试并与用户定义的基线模型比较。引入基于最大边际相关性（MMR）的Profile-Diverse Retention（PDR）策略，在实例级运行时向量上保持行为多样性的上下文。在八个CSPLib问题上的评估表明：迭代重构可带来显著的保留集加速；保持上下文多样性的策略优于仅保留最近或最快尝试的策略；基于验证的选择进一步提升了加速效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然LLM能从自然语言生成正确的约束模型，但模型性能对建模选择敏感，导致正确模型可能求解代价高昂。现有工作缺乏自动化面向性能的模型重构，因此本文探索LLM能否自动进行性能导向的模型重构。

Method: 采用演化框架，LLM作为变异算子提出候选重构，通过验证和基准测试筛选改进。引入Profile-Diverse Retention（PDR）策略，利用Maximal Marginal Relevance（MMR）对实例级运行时向量进行选择，保留行为多样性的历史尝试，以丰富提示上下文。对比了多种上下文保留策略（如保留最近、最快或多样性尝试）。

Result: 在八个CSPLib问题上的实验表明：（i）迭代重构能够产生显著的保留集加速；（ii）保留多样上下文的策略优于仅保留最近或最快尝试的策略；（iii）基于验证的最终模型选择进一步提升了所有策略的保留集加速效果。

Conclusion: LLM能够有效自动化面向性能的约束模型重构，通过引入多样性保留策略和验证选择机制，可以显著提升模型求解性能。

Abstract: Combinatorial problems appear in numerous industrial applications. A common approach is to formulate these problems as declarative constraint models that can subsequently be compiled to and solved by a range of back-end solvers. Recent work shows that Large Language Models (LLMs) can produce correct models from natural language, but even a correct model can be expensive to solve because performance remains sensitive to modelling choices. In this work, we investigate whether LLMs can automate performance-oriented model reformulation. Inspired by Automatic Heuristic Design (AHD), we use an evolutionary framework in which an LLM proposes candidate reformulations that are verified and benchmarked against the user-defined baseline model. We compare AHD-adapted search strategies that control which prior attempts, instructions, and measured feedback enter each prompt. Existing retention strategies prioritize recency or performance, but do not explicitly diversify the context. To cover this gap, we introduce Profile-Diverse Retention (PDR), which applies Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) to instance-level runtime vectors to retain behaviourally diverse attempts. We systematically evaluate the strategies on eight CSPLib problems using validation-based final model selection. The results show that: (i) iterative reformulation can produce substantial held-out speedups; (ii) strategies that keep the retained context diverse outperform those that retain only recent or the fastest attempts; and (iii) validation-based selection improves the held-out speedup of every strategy.

</details>


### [271] [MemHarness: Memory Is Reconstructed, Not Replayed](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28272)
*Rong Wu,Daocheng Fu,Licheng Wen,Xuemeng Yang,Shu Zou,Jianbiao Mei,Yuxin Wang,Hairong Zhang,Yu Yang,Tao Hu,Cong Zhang,Botian Shi,Pinlong Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MemHarness 提出基于当前上下文对检索到的历史经验进行批判与重构（而非直接回放）的框架，通过 GRPO 端到端训练让 LLM 智能体主动利用和改造过去经验，在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上显著优于纯 RL 与静态记忆增强基线，并展现出强 OOD 鲁棒性，同时防止负迁移、提升内在推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆增强智能体将检索到的经验视为静态记录直接回放，忽略了存储经验的抽象通用性与决策时具体多变状态之间的差距，常导致负迁移。而人类会重组和调整记忆以适应当前情境，受此启发设计 MemHarness。

Method: 提出 MemHarness 框架：在每个决策步骤，统一策略模型基于当前状态对检索到的经验进行批判（critique）和重构（reconstruct），产生上下文引导（context-grounded guidance）后再行动。重构能力通过 GRPO 进行端到端训练自然涌现。

Result: 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上的实验表明 MemHarness 大幅优于纯 RL 和静态记忆增强基线，在 OOD 场景下具有强鲁棒性。分析表明重构目标不仅能防止负迁移，还能在训练中作为潜在引导（latent guidance），从根本上改善智能体的内在推理能力。

Conclusion: 基于经验重构的范式比直接回放更有效，能够弥合抽象经验与具体状态之间的鸿沟，增强智能体的泛化和推理能力。

Abstract: Retrieving past experiences has become a common strategy to enhance large language model agents. However, most existing memory-augmented agents treat retrieved experiences as static records to be replayed verbatim, injecting them into the context regardless of whether they align with the agent's current situation. This ``replay'' paradigm ignores the gap between the abstract, general nature of stored experience and the concrete, ever-changing states encountered at decision time, frequently causing negative transfer. In contrast, humans rarely recall past experiences verbatim; instead, they reorganize and adapt retrieved memories to fit the present context. Inspired by this, we propose MemHarness, a framework that equips LLM agents to actively harness and reconstruct past experiences based on the present context. At each decision step, a unified policy model critiques and reconstructs the retrieved experience conditioned on the current state, producing context-grounded guidance before acting. This reconstructive ability emerges naturally through end-to-end training with GRPO. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop show that MemHarness substantially outperforms pure RL and static memory-augmented baselines, demonstrating strong robustness in out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios. Furthermore, our analyses reveal that this reconstruction objective not only prevents negative transfer but also serves as latent guidance during training, fundamentally improving the agent's intrinsic reasoning capabilities.

</details>


### [272] [Tycho: Active Abstraction with Programmatic World Models for ARC-AGI-3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28287)
*Jens Lehmann,Andrei Aioanei,Sahar Vahdati*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ARC-AGI-3，将抽象推理转化为交互式技能获取问题，并介绍Tycho——一个在交互过程中构建和使用游戏特定模型的编码智能体系统。Tycho将可行动观察与中间动画、关卡完成和游戏结束帧分离，使智能体能够建模、测试、规划、修复或绕过可执行假设。通过四种编排策略的对比，演员请求委托给模型构建器策略获得最高平均相对人类行动效率（RHAE 88.49）。在该策略下，GPT-5.6 Sol和Opus 5均达到100.00 RHAE并完成全部183个关卡，Opus 5使用比官方人类基线少61%的计分动作。论文将"何时构建、修复、使用或绕过模型"的联合问题定义为"主动抽象"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统抽象推理任务通常是被动的静态评测，而ARC-AGI-3将抽象转化为交互式技能获取问题，要求智能体在交互代价高昂（每一步都算数）的条件下，同时推断未知游戏的规则、隐藏状态和目标。现有方法缺乏在交互过程中动态构建和利用游戏模型的机制，且未能系统性地解决"何时值得构建或使用模型"这一元决策问题。

Method: 将环境形式化为参数化渲染的确定性摩尔机；提出Tycho编码智能体系统，在交互中将观察分离为可行动观察与中间动画/关卡完成/游戏结束帧，从结构化历史中构建、测试、规划、修复或绕过自由形式的可执行假设。采用四种编排策略（包括演员请求委托给模型构建器、自动修复等）在25个公共游戏上进行对比，使用Claude Opus 4.8在匹配推理预算下运行。

Result: 演员请求委托给模型构建器策略获得最高平均RHAE（88.49）。选定策略下，GPT-5.6 Sol和Opus 5均达100.00 RHAE并完成全部183个关卡，游戏平衡的首次运行人类回放中位排名分别为98.5和100.0。Opus 5使用比官方人类基线少61%的计分动作。自动修复策略虽能更准确再现观察到的转换，但仅达83.07 RHAE。

Conclusion: 仅匹配转换（模拟器能否再现观察到的动态）不足以衡量智能体是否识别目标或改进下一步行动。强表现还需要决定何时构建、修复、使用或绕过模型。论文将这一联合问题定义为"主动抽象"：从高代价交互中生成可测试模型，并判断获取或使用模型是否值得其成本。这为交互式抽象推理研究指明了新的核心方向。

Abstract: ARC-AGI-3 turns abstraction into an interactive problem of skill acquisition. A player must infer an unfamiliar game's rules, hidden state, and goal while maintaining action efficiency because every move counts. We formalize these environments as parameterized rendered deterministic Moore machines and introduce Tycho, a coding-agent system that constructs and uses game-specific models during interaction. Tycho separates actionable observations from intermediate animation, level-completion, and game-over frames. From this structured history, an agent can model, test, plan with, repair, or bypass a free-form executable hypothesis.
  In one matched public-set run per policy, we compare four orchestration policies on all 25 public games using Claude Opus 4.8 under matched inference budgets. Actor-requested delegation to a model builder obtains the highest observed mean Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE), 88.49. With this selected policy, GPT-5.6 Sol and Opus 5 both reach 100.00 RHAE and complete all 183 levels. Their game-balanced first-run human-replay midranks are 98.5 and 100.0. Opus 5 uses 61% fewer scored actions than the aggregate official human baselines.
  Automatic repair after verification failures produces models that reproduce observed transitions much more accurately, yet reaches only 83.07 RHAE. Transition match indicates whether a simulator reproduces observed dynamics, not whether it has identified the objective or improves the next action. Strong play also requires deciding when to construct, repair, use, or bypass a model. We call this joint problem active abstraction: generating a testable model from costly interaction and deciding when acquiring or using it is worth its cost.

</details>


### [273] [One Human, $N$ Agents: Audit-Budget Allocation for LLM Agent Fleets under Miscalibrated, Correlated Confidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28317)
*Cesare Zavattari,Alessandro Tommasi,Giuseppe Prencipe*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了在有限审计预算下人类监督多个LLM智能体的问题，提出了基于高斯copula的预算受限噪声检验模型，发现了置信度排序审计在失校准阈值δ*后比随机审计更差的现象，并实证了开源模型的置信度近乎恒定而无用，而专有模型的置信度具有信息量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在LLM智能体规模远大于人类审计预算的场景中，依赖智能体自报置信度进行审计可能因对抗性失校准和相关错误而失效，需要理论分析何时置信度排序审计优于随机审计，以及如何量化"空洞监督"。

Method: 将问题建模为两层高斯copula下的预算受限噪声检验，推导失校准阈值δ*；在五个开源LLM和一个专有模型上进行实证，分析其置信度校准特性；并提出空洞监督的定量判据，在记录轨迹上回放策略验证排序。

Result: 发现两个反直觉现象：δ*随预算缩减而上升（而非下降），跨系列相关性并非很低（共享难度主导而非家族差异）。五个开源LLM的置信度近乎恒定（操作上无用），点估计位于或超过翻转点但置信区间跨越；专有模型置信度具有信息量且低于阈值。

Conclusion: 置信度排序审计的有效性取决于失校准程度δ与预算的关系，开源模型当前置信度信息不足以指导审计分配，而专有模型可提供有用信号；给出的空洞监督判据可用于评估实际审计策略。

Abstract: A single human must audit $N$ LLM agents under a budget of $B \ll N$ audits per round, guided by self-reported confidence that may be adversarially miscalibrated and by correlated errors. We model this as budgeted noisy inspection over a two-level Gaussian copula and locate the miscalibration threshold $δ^*$ past which confidence-ranked auditing is \emph{worse} than random. Two a-priori expectations reverse: $δ^*$ \emph{rises} as the budget shrinks, and cross-family correlation is not low---shared difficulty dominates lineage. Five open-weight LLMs show operationally useless (near-constant) confidence, point estimates at or beyond the flip though CIs straddle it; a proprietary model is informative and lands below it. We give a quantitative criterion for \emph{vacuous} oversight, and replaying policies on recorded traces confirms the ordering.

</details>


### [274] [PathView-Bench: Can Multimodal Large Language Models Achieve Fine-grained Multiscale Understanding of Pathology Images?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28318)
*Zongyi Chen,Yu Liang,Jie Lin,Liansheng Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PathVU是一个面向计算病理学中细粒度、多尺度视觉理解的基准测试，包含14个VQA任务、6万多张图像、30万多个样本，覆盖28个器官和700多万个标注。评估了18个主流多模态大语言模型，发现即使是先进模型在多尺度病理图像的细粒度视觉任务上仍存在显著局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有病理多模态基准主要考评最终诊断答案、标题或报告，未能充分测试模型对病理推理所需的细粒度、多尺度视觉内容的理解能力。

Method: PathVU从23个公开病理影像数据集构建，包含人监督的标签和空间标注。将原始标注转化为确定性任务目标，支持区域定位、视觉识别、数量估计、空间推理和上下文不足判断等任务的程序化评分。涵盖两种视野：Region FOV（高分辨率局部区域）和Slide FOV（宏观全切片视图）。

Result: 评估了18个代表性通用、医学领域和病理导向的多模态大语言模型，发现即使在先进模型中，在多尺度病理图像上的细粒度视觉任务仍存在显著局限性。

Conclusion: PathVU为开发和评估具有显式多尺度视觉理解能力的病理多模态大语言模型提供了可重复的基准。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to analyze pathology images. However, dominant multimodal benchmarks in pathology mainly score final diagnostic answers, captions, or reports. These evaluations provide limited insight into whether a model understands the multiscale visual content needed for pathology reasoning and decision-making. We introduce PathVU, a vision-anchored benchmark for fine-grained and multiscale visual understanding in computational pathology. Built from 23 public pathology imaging datasets with human-supervised labels and spatial annotations, PathVU evaluates MLLM understanding in two fields of view: Region FOV for high-resolution local regions and Slide FOV for macro whole-slide views. By converting raw annotations into deterministic task targets, PathVU enables programmatic scoring of region localization, visual recognition, quantity estimation, spatial reasoning, and insufficient-context judgment. The benchmark contains 14 VQA-style tasks, 61,673 images, and 308,070 samples across 28 organs and 7,253,526 annotations. Evaluating 18 representative general-purpose, medical-domain, and pathology-oriented MLLMs, we observe substantial limitations even in advanced models on fine-grained visual tasks across multiscale pathology images. PathVU provides a reproducible basis for developing and evaluating pathology MLLMs with explicit multiscale visual understanding.

</details>


### [275] [Paying for Honesty Without Knowing the Truth: Reputation-Penalty Design for LLM Marketplace Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28330)
*Mingdai Yang,Shicheng Fan,Kejing Yu,Duohao Wang,Li Sun,Hao Peng,Philip S. Yu,Zhiwei Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究LLM智能体作为自主商家时，即使在诚实指令下也会因竞争压力虚构商品属性。平台无法验证每个声明（仅能获取有偏的投诉信号），为此提出CARP声誉惩罚机制（含死区容忍噪声、状态依赖严重性）和SPARC代码门控反思机制。CARP无需真实标签即可抑制低评分撒谎者的销量，保护诚实卖家；结合SPARC能弥补大部分消费者福利差距。实验表明，LLM商家在撒谎无成本时会虚构，但面临销量惩罚时自我约束，这种绑定行为源于惩罚门控的自我纠正推理，而非简单合规。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体作为自主商家时，在竞争压力下会虚构产品属性以赢得销售，即使被要求诚实。平台无法直接验证每个声明的真实性，只能观察到有噪声且存在偏误的投诉信号。因此需要一种无需真实标签、能抵抗策略性博弈的声誉机制来保护消费者并惩罚不诚实商家。

Method: 提出CARP（声誉惩罚机制）和SPARC（字节干净代码门控反思机制）。CARP包含死区（容忍投诉噪声）和状态依赖的惩罚严重性（对抗声誉驱动的检测侵蚀），无需产品级真实标签。SPARC通过代码门控实现反思：LLM商家在撒谎无成本时会虚构，但若撒谎导致销量损失（通过CARP实施惩罚）则会自我约束。两者结合形成完整方案。

Result: CARP能在无需真实标签的情况下有效抑制低评分撒谎者的销量，同时保护诚实卖家。与SPARC配合，能弥补大部分相对于完美信息基准的消费者福利差距，在所有比较的政策中福利最优。LLM商家的行为模式为：当撒谎成本为零时虚构；当撒谎导致销量惩罚（通过CARP）时自我约束，这是一种自利响应而非合规。这种绑定行为可通过惩罚门控的自我纠正推理来解释，并在多个模型上得到验证。

Conclusion: 通过设计无需真实标签的CARP声誉机制和SPARC反思机制，可以有效约束LLM商家在竞争环境下的虚构行为。关键洞察在于让撒谎产生实质性销售惩罚，从而触发商家的自利性自我纠正，而非依赖道德合规。该方法在实践中可保护消费者，且具有鲁棒性。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly act as autonomous merchants that write their own product listings, and under competitive pressure, they fabricate attributes to win sales. Even under instructions to be honest, they fabricate attributes in a majority of listings across models. A platform's obvious remedy---verifying each claim against the truth---is unavailable, because it observes only a noisy, biased complaint signal, never the ground truth. We design CARP, a reputation-penalty mechanism with a deadband that forgives complaint noise and a state-dependent severity that counters reputation-driven detection erosion. CARP requires no product-level ground truth and is robust to strategic gaming. CARP protects consumers by suppressing the sales volume of low-rated liars while sparing honest sellers. Paired with SPARC, it closes most of the consumer-welfare gap relative to a perfect-information oracle, without ever accessing the truth. It also achieves the best welfare of the policies we compare. We further show that this felt penalty becomes behaviorally binding through SPARC, a byte-clean code-gated reflection mechanism: LLM merchants fabricate when lying is free but restrain themselves when fabrication costs them sales, a self-interested response rather than compliance. We trace this distinction to penalty-gated self-correction reasoning, and observe the binding across models, with supporting confidence intervals.

</details>


### [276] [Correcting What You Cannot See: Credit Assignment for Perception Distillation in Multimodal Reasoners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28336)
*Feng Xiong,Leyan Xue,Hongyu Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 一种无标签的方法，通过下游失败与师生分歧的乘积作为软AND门，识别多模态推理中可纠正的感知错误，从而改进蒸馏效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏的轨迹级奖励无法区分失败源于感知错误还是推理错误；感知成功率（PSR）因低成功率混淆了感知不足与推理难度而存在歧义。

Method: 提出感知纠正蒸馏（PCD），采用分离的感知-推理 rollout 和均值保持权重，利用下游失败与师生分歧作为互补证据，通过贝叶斯组合推导出乘积形式的软AND门，仅在两个证据同时存在时加强蒸馏。

Result: 在八个基准上，PCD 将 8B→2B 宏观平均值从 44.50（OPD）提升至 47.28，32B→8B 从 56.94 提升至 61.22；消融实验显示移除 PCD 和分离 rollout 分别导致留出平均下降 2.22 和 0.88 分。

Conclusion: 有效的多模态蒸馏不仅取决于教师预测的内容，还取决于识别何时感知是适当的纠正目标。

Abstract: On-policy distillation provides dense supervision for multimodal reasoners, but its trajectory-level reward cannot determine whether a failed answer arose from perception or subsequent reasoning. Perception Success Rate (PSR), estimated from multiple reasonings sharing one perception, remains ambiguous because low success conflates perceptual insufficiency with reasoning difficulty. We introduce \textbf{Perception-Correction Distillation (PCD)}, a label-free method that identifies correctable perception failures using downstream failure and teacher--student disagreement as complementary witnesses. Their product, , forms a soft AND gate that strengthens distillation only when both witnesses are present. We motivate this rule through Bayesian evidence combination and show that multiplication is the unique normalized bilinear gate that vanishes when either witness is absent. PCD uses separated perception--reasoning rollouts and mean-preserving weights, leaving the reasoning objective unchanged. Across eight benchmarks, PCD improves the 8B 2B macro average from 44.50 with OPD to 47.28 and the 32B 8B result from 56.94 to 61.22. In matched 2B ablations, removing PCD and separated rollout reduces held-out average by 2.22 and 0.88 points, respectively. Effective multimodal distillation therefore depends not only on what the teacher predicts, but also on identifying when perception is the appropriate target of correction.

</details>


### [277] [How Benchmarks Mis-Score Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28367)
*Zihan Dong,Zhiyuan Ma,Zekun Wang,Yunqing Li,Zirou Liu,Ruixuan Deng,Qishi Zhan,Rui Qian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 当前计算机使用智能体（CUA）基准测试的评分存在系统性不可靠问题，包括任务陈旧、轨迹缺乏关键视觉证据、评估者误判、报告掩盖失败原因。作者通过审计150个失败轨迹发现15.3%的FAIL判定是错误的，并提出了一个三层次诊断分类法和分阶段设计规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CUA基准测试的评分过程存在诸多不可靠因素（任务过时、评估偏差、报告不透明等），导致分数无法真实反映智能体能力，亟需系统性的可靠性框架来识别和纠正这些问题。

Method: 1）构建了一个涵盖任务构建、轨迹观察、评分和报告四个阶段的可靠性框架；2）审计了来自五个基准（网页、企业工作流、桌面控制）的150个公开失败评分轨迹，手动检查评估正确性；3）对真实失败案例提出三层次诊断分类法。

Result: 发现15.3%的FAIL判定是错误的：10.7%是评估器假阴性（实际成功被误判为失败），4.7%是任务本身有缺陷。在真正的失败中，验证/反馈和规划错误占主导，而执行/基础错误较少；单一成功率指标无法解释失败原因。

Conclusion: 需要改进CUA评估的可靠性：采用更丰富的评估指标、确保轨迹包含视觉证据、建立标准化的失败分类体系，并为长期任务设计分阶段的评估规则。

Abstract: Computer-use agents (CUA) are being deployed to browse the web and operate desktop software, yet their benchmark scores are still commonly produced by brittle scripted oracles. A score is the output of a pipeline in which tasks can be stale, trajectories can omit decisive visual evidence, evaluators can reject valid alternatives, and aggregate reports can hide the cause of failure. We organize these problems into a reliability framework spanning task construction, trajectory observation, scoring, and reporting. We then audit 150 public failure-scored trajectories from five web, enterprise-workflow, and desktop-control benchmarks, find that 15.3\% of FAIL verdicts are wrong: 10.7\% are evaluator false negatives and 4.7\% are broken tasks. For genuine failures, a three-tier diagnostic taxonomy shows that verification/feedback and planning failures dominate execution/grounding errors, while a single scalar success rate can not explain. We connect these findings to newer long-horizon CUA benchmarks and derive stage-specific design rules for CUA evaluation.

</details>


### [278] [When Specifications Conflict: A Symmetry-Based Framework for Measuring LLM Preferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28384)
*Tairan Wang,Liang Zhou,Zikang Zhan,Pingchuan Yan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一个可控实验框架，用于研究LLM在冲突规范下的偏好选择。通过在数学基准（550个实例，11个函数族）上评估四种表示类型（纯自然语言、形式语言、自然化形式语言、输入-输出示例），发现系统性的偏好排序：形式语言≈自然化形式语言 > 纯自然语言 > 输入-输出示例。该框架还可推广到布尔代数、代码生成和临床领域的异构规范冲突。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM需要整合多源信息，但这些信息可能不一致或冲突，而目前缺乏可控、可归因的方法来分析模型如何解决冲突规范。现有研究未能系统性地比较不同表示类型下的冲突解决偏好。

Method: 构建了具有显式冲突的规范对，通过对称性设计减少混淆因素，允许直接观察模型在竞争规范间的选择。在可执行的数学基准上评估了四种表示类型（纯自然语言、形式语言、自然化形式语言、输入-输出示例），并扩展到布尔代数、代码生成和临床领域。

Result: 显示出系统性偏好模式而非随机行为，偏好顺序为：形式语言≈自然化形式语言 > 纯自然语言 > 输入-输出示例。示例效应取决于模型能力和函数族。该框架可推广到多种任务和规范形式。

Conclusion: 提供了一个统一的方法来测量LLM如何解决竞争信息源之间的冲突，揭示了LLM在不同表示类型下的系统偏好，有助于理解模型行为并提高可控性和可归因性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly required to integrate multiple sources of information that may be inconsistent or conflicting. However, there is still a lack of controllable and attributable methods for analyzing how models resolve conflicts between competing specifications. We propose a controlled experimental framework for studying model preferences under conflicting specifications. By constructing specifications with explicit conflicts, the framework enables model choices between competing specifications to be directly observed and analyzed. A symmetry-based design further reduces confounding factors, allowing preferences across representation types to be compared systematically.
  We evaluate the framework on an executable mathematical benchmark with 550 conflict instances spanning 11 function families, comparing four representation types: pure natural language, formal language, naturalized formal language, and input--output examples. Results show systematic preference patterns rather than random behavior, with a consistent ordering: $ \text{Formal} \approx \text{Naturalized Formal} > \text{Pure Natural Language} > \text{Input--Output Examples} $. Example effects further depend on model capability and function family.
  We extend the framework to heterogeneous specification conflicts in Boolean algebra, code generation, and the clinical domain, demonstrating its applicability across diverse tasks and specification forms. The framework provides a unified approach for measuring how LLMs resolve conflicts between competing sources of information.

</details>


### [279] [QuantWAMs: Calibrating at the Right Granularity for World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28405)
*Jiacheng Zhou,Jinfan Lv,Ruixuan Li,Longtai Zhang,Yan Wang,Wenqiang Zhang,Lizhe Qi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了 QuantWAMs，一种针对世界动作模型（WAM）的后训练量化框架，通过共享基异常校准、共训练目标显著性和固定干预 rollout 审计三种策略，在 W4A4 量化下将仿真性能损失控制在 FP16 的 0.2-0.7 个百分点内，并将峰值权重-激活内存降至 FP16 的约 29%，实现 1.4-1.6 倍的块级加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WAM 的迭代去噪和闭环执行导致部署成本高昂，而现有 PTQ 方法因依赖开环目标、同质模型假设和与部署不符的校准分布，难以适用于 WAM。

Method: 提出 QuantWAMs 框架，包含三种策略：(1) 共享基异常校准——仅在坐标兼容模块间池化激活证据；(2) 共训练目标显著性——从联合视频-动作梯度计算经验 Fisher 分数，并在校准稳定的层粒度分配权重精度；(3) 固定干预 rollout 审计——利用可达闭环状态修订去噪步保护调度，不改变精度预算。

Result: 在 Fast-WAM 和 LingBot-VA 上，基于 RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO 和真实机器人 AgiBot G2 操作任务评估。W4A4 主导设置下仿真均值与 FP16 相差 0.2-0.7 个百分点；真实机器人实验验证了部署可行性；峰值权重-激活内存降至 FP16 的约 29%，块级加速 1.4-1.6 倍。

Conclusion: QuantWAMs 通过将量化决策与模型结构、 rollout 分布和任务目标定义的校准上下文对齐，有效解决了 WAM 的高效部署问题，在保持性能的同时大幅降低内存和计算开销。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly predict future observations and actions, but their iterative denoising and closed-loop execution make efficient deployment costly. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods are poorly suited to WAMs because they rely on open-loop objectives, homogeneous model assumptions, and calibration distributions that do not reflect deployment. We present QuantWAMs, a PTQ framework that aligns quantization decisions with the calibration context defined by model structure, rollout distribution, and task objective. QuantWAMs introduces three strategies: shared-basis outlier calibration, which pools activation evidence only across coordinate-compatible modules; co-training-objective saliency, which computes empirical-Fisher scores from the joint video--action gradient and assigns weight precision at a calibration-stable layer granularity; and fixed-intervention rollout auditing, which revises denoising-step protection schedules using reachable closed-loop states without changing the precision budget. We evaluate QuantWAMs on Fast-WAM and LingBot-VA across RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, and real-robot manipulation with an AgiBot G2. Under a W4A4-dominant setting, the reported simulation means differ from FP16 by 0.2--0.7 percentage points. Real-robot trials further establish deployment feasibility on three manipulation tasks. For the targeted video and action blocks, QuantWAMs reduces peak weight-and-activation memory to about 29\% of FP16 and provides 1.4--1.6$\times$ block-level speedups.

</details>


### [280] [When Derived Measurements Mislead: Quantifying and Mitigating LLM Over-Trust with Privileged-Modality Reliability Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28421)
*Zongheng Guo,Tao Chen,Tianli Li,Mingzhe Cui,Yang Jiao,Lei Xie,Yi Pan,Xiao Hu,Manuela Ferrario*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出“派生特征过度信任（DFOT）”概念，指下游LLM将派生测量（如PPG信号推算的心率）当作直接事实或超出有效范围使用。以生理信号PPG-ECG为案例，设计了两个测试（D1：接受被ECG矛盾的PPG结论；D2：拒绝被ECG证实的PPG结论），用五个估计量（COTR、CIR、CRR、ESRM、UHR）量化信任链错误。基于5万条记录和187名患者的测试，基线方法在修复和特异性指标上提升1.82-6.69个百分点，UHR增加0.67个百分点。DFOT为更强缓解方法提供了统一评估目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 派生测量（如PPG衍生的心率）越来越多地作为直接事实进入LLM管道，但其有效性依赖于具体实例。LLM可能错误地将这些测量视为可靠事实（过度信任），导致推理错误。现有研究缺乏对此类“派生特征过度信任”问题的系统定义和量化框架。

Method: 定义DFOT问题，以生理信号PPG-ECG为案例：（1）D1测试LLM是否接受被离线ECG矛盾的PPG派生结论；（2）D2测试LLM是否在误导性病史下拒绝被ECG证实的可靠PPG结论。设计五个估计量：冲突过度信任率（COTR）、上下文诱导错误率（CIR）、正确修复率（CRR）、证据特异性修复边际（ESRM）、效用损害率（UHR）。采用ECG-to-PPG特权蒸馏作为基线与仅PPG推理对比，在5万对PPG-ECG记录上训练，在187名患者上测试。

Result: 在187名患者的协议锁定测试中，基线方法（ECG-to-PPG特权蒸馏）在四个修复和特异性指标上提升1.82-6.69个百分点，所有配对置信区间排除零；UHR增加0.67个百分点（95% CI: -0.4到+1.7，无显著差异）。方法不依赖特定可靠性生成器。

Conclusion: DFOT提供了一个通用评估目标，用于衡量和改进LLM对派生测量过度信任的问题。该框架不依赖特定可靠性生成器，可推广到其他领域。代码已开源。

Abstract: Derived measurements increasingly enter large language model (LLM) pipelines as direct facts despite their instance-dependent validity. We define derived-feature over-trust (DFOT) as the failure in which a downstream LLM assigns such a measurement the epistemic status of a direct fact or uses it outside its valid scope. Using physiological sensing as a case study, D1 tests acceptance of a PPG-derived rhythm contradicted by offline ECG, whereas D2 tests rejection of an offline-confirmed reliable PPG rhythm under misleading severe history. ECG supplies training supervision and offline reference construction but is never shown to the LLM. Five estimands quantify this chain: conflict over-trust rate (COTR) and context-induced error rate (CIR) characterize D1/D2; correct repair rate (CRR) measures frozen-error repair; evidence-specific repair margin (ESRM) contrasts matched and patient-disjoint shuffled evidence; and utility harm rate (UHR) measures unnecessary verification among HIGH-reliability cases used without verification at baseline. The framework does not depend on a particular reliability generator. We demonstrate it on 50,000 paired PPG-ECG records using ECG-to-PPG privileged distillation as an illustrative baseline and PPG-only inference. On a protocol-locked 187-patient test, the baseline improves four repair and specificity endpoints by 1.82-6.69 percentage points, with all paired confidence intervals excluding zero; UHR increases by 0.67 percentage points (95% CI: -0.4 to +1.7). DFOT provides a common evaluation target for stronger mitigation methods. The code is available at https://github.com/Zongheng-Guo/When-Derived-Measurements-Mislead.

</details>


### [281] [A foundation model of numerical intelligence with cross-disciplinary generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28432)
*Chenghan Wu,Zongmin Yu,Liu Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出UNICON（统一上下文算子网络），一种具备数值智能的基础模型。它通过图结构示例作为上下文，从数值数据中推断预测关系并应用于新查询，跨学科（包括训练中未见过的学科）接近甚至超越专家性能。结合语言模型可进一步提升表现，训练数据多样性有助于泛化至未见学科。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型擅长从文本语境中获取知识，但科学和社会系统常涉及数值上下文，需要模型能从数值数据中获取并应用知识（即数值智能）。目前缺乏统一的基础模型来处理此类数值推理任务。

Method: 提出UNICON（UNified In-Context Operator Networks），利用图结构示例作为上下文，从给定系统的数值数据中推断共享的预测关系，并将其应用于同一系统的查询。该模型基于上下文学习（in-context learning）范式，不依赖微调即可跨学科泛化。

Result: UNICON在多个科学与社会系统（包括训练中未涉及的学科）上接近专家性能而无需重新训练。与语言模型代理结合后，在未见学科的基准上超越最先进的专家模型。实验还表明训练语料的多样性可改善对未见学科的泛化能力。

Conclusion: UNICON可被视为数值智能的基础模型，为构建更广泛的人工智能生态系统提供基础模块。数值智能与语言智能互补，有望推动科学与社会系统中的AI应用。

Abstract: Intelligence is commonly understood as the ability to acquire and apply knowledge, adapt to unfamiliar situations and solve new problems. Large language models exhibit this capacity by inferring task-relevant knowledge from textual context and applying it to new tasks. Yet intelligence need not be confined to language. For scientific and social systems, we need models that acquire and apply knowledge from numerical context-an ability we call numerical intelligence. Here we introduce UNified In-Context Operator Networks (UNICON), a foundation model that exhibits numerical intelligence across disciplines. Using graph-based examples from a system as context, UNICON infers the predictive relation shared across them and applies it to queries from the same system. Across scientific and social systems, including those from disciplines absent from training, the same model approaches specialist performance without retraining. Combining UNICON with language-model agents yields further gains, enabling it to surpass state-of-the-art specialists in a discipline unseen in training. We further show that training-corpus diversity improves generalization to unseen disciplines. Together, these results establish UNICON as a foundation model of numerical intelligence and position it as a building block for a broader ecosystem of artificial intelligence.

</details>


### [282] [LeanCSP: A Framework for Certifying Constraint Reformulation and Solving in Lean](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28459)
*Pablo Manrique,Stefan Szeider*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文在Lean定理证明器中构建了一个约束编程验证框架，同时支持配方层级的等价性、可满足等价性和对称性破缺正确性的参数化证明，以及通过翻译后端（MiniZinc、SMT-LIB、OPB）对求解器产生的每个实例证书进行独立检查。两者结合形成端到端工作流，无需信任外部求解器即可确立问题的可满足性或不可满足性。实验表明，验证过的对称性破缺可将求解器搜索空间减少高达2×10^7倍，而整个Lean内的认证开销至多只需几分钟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 约束编程广泛应用于调度、规划、配置和验证等复杂组合问题，但其结果的可信度面临双重挑战：一是问题在求解前经过的转化（reformulation）必须保持语义不变，二是求解器本身必须给出正确结果。现有方法往往只解决其中一层，且缺乏对问题族参数化证明的支持。

Method: 利用Lean定理证明器构建统一框架，包含两层验证：(1) 公式层（formulation-level）：对问题族参量化证明等价性、可满足等价性及对称性破缺约束的正确性；(2) 实例层（instance-level）：通过翻译后端将问题导出为MiniZinc、SMT-LIB、OPB等外部求解器格式，并验证求解器返回的证书（certificate）。两层结合形成不依赖外部求解器可信度的端到端工作流。

Result: 实验结果显示：(1) 验证过的对称性破缺约束可将求解器搜索空间减少最高达2×10^7倍；(2) 完整的Lean内认证过程开销可接受，最大规模实例也仅需几分钟。

Conclusion: 该工作首次在同一个定理证明器中同时实现约束编程的配方层和实例层验证，提供了端到端的可信求解流程。参数化证明使得同一问题族的所有规模实例共享一份证明，极大降低了验证成本；实际性能数据也表明该框架具有实用价值。

Abstract: Constraint programming is a core technology for solving complex combinatorial problems in scheduling, planning, configuration, and verification. Trusting its results therefore demands guarantees at two levels: that reformulations applied beforehand are semantics-preserving, and that solvers produce correct answers. In this work, we introduce a framework that addresses both verification levels in the Lean theorem prover: it can be used to prove formulation-level properties, such as equivalence, equisatisfiability, and the correctness of symmetry-breaking constraints, parametrically for entire problem families; and to check solver-produced certificates for individual instances via translation backends to external formats such as MiniZinc, SMT-LIB, and OPB. Combining both levels yields an end-to-end workflow that establishes the satisfiability or unsatisfiability of a constraint problem without trusting the external solver. Experimental results show that our framework's verified symmetry breaking also pays off in practice: a single parametric proof per problem family, reused across all instance sizes, reduces solver search effort by a factor of up to 2x10^7, while the entire in-Lean certification stays affordable, taking at most a few minutes for our largest instances.

</details>


### [283] [A report-grounded vision-language foundation model for colonoscopy from 280000 routine reports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28466)
*Jia Yu,Yan Zhu,Yili He,Zilong Wang,Xinyang Jiang,Peiyao Fu,Ruijie Yang,Tianyi Chen,Siyuan Li,Zhihua Wang,Fei Wu,Quanlin Li,Xian Yang,Pinghong Zhou,Shuo Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EndoCLIP是一个在结肠镜报告-图像对上进行训练的视觉-语言基础模型，通过从28万份常规结肠镜记录中恢复12.5万个病灶级图文对，在零样本和线性探测设置下优于通用及生物医学视觉-语言编码器，其线性探测在良恶性分类上接近12名内镜专家的水平，表明恢复图文对应关系可将常规文档转化为可扩展的监督信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言模型在结肠镜领域使用不足，因为常规报告中虽然记录了丰富的专家描述（病灶外观、大小、位置），但报告是对整个过程的总结而非逐帧标注，导致临床发现与对应图像之间的关联较弱。

Method: 从280,476份常规结肠镜记录中渐进式恢复出125,756个病灶级图像-文本对，训练EndoCLIP视觉-语言基础模型。

Result: 在病灶级图文检索、结构化报告生成和六个多中心临床分类任务中，EndoCLIP在零样本和线性探测设置下均优于通用及生物医学视觉-语言编码器；在良恶性分类上，其线性探测在包含12名内镜专家的盲法研究中接近专家读者的表现。

Conclusion: 恢复发现与帧的对应关系可将常规文档转化为可扩展的监督信号，使得临床目标能够通过语言而非为每个任务单独标注来指定。

Abstract: Vision-language models remain underused in colonoscopy despite the rich expert descriptions recorded in routine reports. These reports document lesion appearance, size and location but summarise entire procedures rather than caption individual frames, leaving clinical findings only weakly linked to the corresponding images. Here we develop EndoCLIP, a colonoscopy vision-language foundation model trained on 125,756 lesion-level image-text pairs progressively recovered from 280,476 routine colonoscopy records. Across lesion-level image-text retrieval, structured report generation and six multi-centre clinical classification tasks, EndoCLIP outperforms general-purpose and biomedical vision-language encoders in both zero-shot and linear-probe settings. On benign-versus-malignant classification, its linear probe approaches the performance of expert readers in a blinded study involving 12 endoscopists. These results suggest that recovering finding-to-frame correspondence can transform routine documentation into scalable supervision, enabling clinical targets to be specified in language rather than separately annotated for each task.

</details>


### [284] [Towards Autonomous Aircraft Surveillance from Nanosatellites through On-Board Inference and Generative Data Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28470)
*Antonio Delgado-Rosa,David Muñoz-Valero,Enrique Adrian Villarrubia-Martin,Juan Moreno-Garcia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种结合在轨推理和生成式数据增强的工作流，利用6U立方星上的低功耗边缘张量加速器进行推理，并通过低秩适应的扩散模型生成合成少数类图像以平衡数据集，最终提升了航空监视的检测精度和实时性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近地轨道航空监视面临两个相互关联的瓶颈：纳米卫星下行链路预算有限，但传统方式仍传输TB级原始图像到地面处理；此外，开放航空器卫星数据集稀缺且类别严重不平衡。这些问题延迟了及时决策，或阻碍标准检测器学习稀有类别的稳健表征。

Method: 提出了一种工作流：(1) 在6U立方星上使用低功耗边缘张量加速器执行在轨推理；(2) 通过低秩适应（LoRA）微调扩散模型，生成合成少数类图像；(3) 合成输出由中间检测器自动标注（伪标签），并与传统增强样本合并，形成平衡数据集。

Result: 平衡数据集使全局平均精度（mAP）从77.9%提升至82.2%，少数类F1分数从0.683提升至0.811；量化后的检测器适配片上内存，在轨可达到25-30帧/秒的处理速度。

Conclusion: 该工作流与传统的“弯管”架构（卫星仅作为被动数据收集器）形成对比，计算测试支持其作为近地轨道纳米卫星实时自主航空监视的决策支持工具。

Abstract: Airborne surveillance from low Earth orbit is hindered by two interconnected bottlenecks: nanosatellites have a limited downlink budget, yet the conventional approach still transmits terabytes of raw imagery to the ground for processing, and open satellite datasets for aircraft are scarce and severely class-imbalanced. These limitations either delay timely decision-making or prevent standard detectors from learning robust representations of rare aircraft classes. In this paper, a workflow that combines on-board inference with generative data augmentation is proposed to address both limitations jointly. Inference is executed on a 6U CubeSat equipped with a low-power edge tensor accelerator, while a diffusion model fine-tuned through low-rank adaptation generates synthetic minority-class imagery. This synthetic output is automatically annotated, pseudo-labelled, by an intermediate detector and merged with classically augmented samples. The results show that the balanced dataset increases global mean average precision from 77.9% to 82.2%, with the minority class rising from F1=0.683 to F1=0.811, and that the quantised detector fits the on-chip memory and projects 25-30 frames per second on orbit. This approach contrasts with the conventional bent-pipe architecture, in which the satellite acts as a passive data collector. Therefore, the computational tests support the proposed workflow as a decision-support tool for real-time, autonomous airborne surveillance from nanosatellites.

</details>


### [285] [A Fuzzy Rule-based Neuro-Symbolic Approach for Pipe Severity Prediction in Sewer Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28481)
*Ngoc Thai Le,Thanh Ma,Umberto Straccia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种模块化、基于模糊规则的神经符号框架，用于自动污水管道严重性评估。该框架将 Swin Transformer 视觉感知与决策树导出的模糊 IF-THEN 规则推理解耦，在五类高度不平衡数据集上相比纯图像分类方法在准确率、平衡准确率、Macro F1 和 MCC 上分别提升 17.9%、12.2%、23.0% 和 17.3%，同时实现了可追溯的推理过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准自动化污水管道严重性评估依赖直接图像分类，形成“黑箱”，视觉缺陷与最终严重性得分之间的联系不透明。作者希望构建一个可解释的框架，将神经感知（视觉特征提取）与符号推理（基于规则的严重性判断）明确解耦，使推理过程可追溯。

Method: 1) 感知模块：使用 Swin Transformer 从图像直接预测 14 个多标签检查 CODE 度数。2) 推理模块：基于真实 CODE 和严重性标签训练决策树（Weka J48），将其路径转换为 19 条固定的 IF-THEN 模糊规则。3) 模糊推理：采用 t-norm（三角范数）激活 CODE 条件，乘以规则置信度，再通过 s-norm（三角余范数）组合生成各类别的可解释证据。评估了 Product、Łukasiewicz 和 Hamacher 三种算子对。4) 真实标签生成：由五个独立大语言模型（LLM）分析原始检查员笔记，通过共识机制生成鲁棒的严重性标签。

Result: 在包含 3,244 张图像、五个高度不平衡严重性类别的数据集上，相比纯图像分类方法：准确率提升 17.9%，平衡准确率提升 12.2%，Macro F1 提升 23.0%，马修斯相关系数（MCC）提升 17.3%。框架在保持竞争性类别平衡性能的同时，提供了从预测 CODE 度数到规则支持度和严重性证据的可追溯推理。

Conclusion: 该神经符号框架有效地将视觉感知与符号推理解耦，在提升分类性能的同时实现了推理过程的可解释性。模糊逻辑的使用使得规则激活程度连续可微，支持从图像到最终严重性判断的完整追溯链，为基础设施评估中的可信 AI 应用提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Standard automated sewer pipe severity assessment relies on direct image classification, creating a "black box" where the link between visual defects and final severity scores remains implicit. This study introduces a modular, fuzzy rule-based neuro-symbolic framework that bridges this gap by decoupling neural perception from symbolic reasoning. The perception module utilizes a Swin Transformer to predict 14 multilabel inspection CODE degrees directly from images. For reasoning, a DT, specifically Weka's J48, algorithm is trained on ground-truth CODEs and severity labels, and its paths are converted into 19 fixed IF--THEN rules. Inference operates via fuzzy logic: t-norm activations from CODE conditions are weighted by rule confidence and combined with corresponding s-norms to produce interpretable class evidence. We assessed Product, Łukasiewicz, and Hamacher operator pairs using a dataset of 3,244 images spanning five highly imbalanced severity classes. Ground-truth labels were robustly generated via consensus from five independent large language models analyzing original inspector notes. Our results show an improvement of accuracy, balanced accuracy, Macro F1 and MCC by 17.9%, 12.2%, 23.0%, and 17.3%, respectively, over image-only based classification.
  Overall, the framework combines competitive class-balanced performance with traceable reasoning from predicted CODE degrees to rule supports and severity evidence.

</details>


### [286] [SCOPE: Supply-Chain Operations through Coupled Policies for End-to-End Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28488)
*Yunhao Liang,Xianqi Cao,Pujun Zhang,Yuan Qu,Yongzhi Qi,Ningxuan Kang,Max Z. J. Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SCOPE框架，通过将供应链实体表示为令牌并共享上下文表示，实现端到端协调的补货计划决策（品类选择、供应商分配、补货频率、路线规划），在生鲜零售场景中基于叮咚买菜和京东的真实数据验证，相比独立优化各环节的方法表现更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代供应链中，品类选择、供应商分配、补货频率和配送路线等运营决策由不同部门通过独立系统分别优化，导致库存短缺、积压和不必要的运输成本。这些决策在操作上紧密耦合，但缺乏统一协调机制。

Method: 提出SCOPE（Supply-Chain Operations through Coupled Policies for End-to-End Coordination）复合策略模型：将供应链实体（品类、仓库、配送路径等）编码为令牌，通过共享的运营表示进行上下文化，每种令牌类型映射到对应的决策接口。每个决策基于之前形成的部分计划，完整计划通过系统级效用函数评估。

Result: 在两大生鲜零售供应链——叮咚买菜（前端补货）和京东（后端补货）的真实运营数据上，SCOPE在端到端绩效上持续优于分别优化各决策阶段的方法以及行业常用的实践基线。

Conclusion: 学习并协调跨部门的运营耦合关系能够产生更有效的端到端供应链决策，证实了统一规划取代孤立决策模块的价值。

Abstract: Can supply-chain AI move beyond isolated decision modules toward unified operational planning? A complete replenishment plan specifies which products each location carries, which upstream facility supplies it, how often it is replenished, and how deliveries are routed. These decisions are operationally coupled: the selected assortment changes the demand and load passed to later stages; source assignment and replenishment frequency reshape the delivery requests; and route feasibility and cost, in turn, determine the system value of the earlier choices. Yet in modern supply chains, these decisions are often handled by separate departments and optimized through separate systems, which can lead to stockouts, inventory exposure, and avoidable transportation. We propose SCOPE: Supply-Chain Operations through Coupled Policies for End-to-End Coordination, a composite policy model that represents supply-chain entities as tokens, contextualizes them through a shared operational representation, and maps each token type to the corresponding decision interface. Each decision builds on the partial plan formed by earlier decisions while the completed plan is evaluated using a shared system-level utility. We instantiate this framework in urban fresh-retail replenishment, where service frequency, assortment, capacity pressure, and road-network routing interact strongly, and evaluate it on real operational data from Dingdong and JD.com, two large-scale supply chains operating at different replenishment echelons. Across both settings, SCOPE consistently outperforms methods that optimize each decision stage separately, as well as practice-oriented baselines commonly used in supply-chain operations. These results show that learning and coordinating cross-department operational couplings lead to more effective end-to-end supply-chain decisions.

</details>


### [287] [InfoOps Bench: A live information operations safety benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28503)
*Dorian Quelle,Lisa-Maria Neudert,Jonathan Bright,John Gallacher*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: This paper presents a dynamic AI benchmark that continuously measures the integrity of frontier language models against being co-opted for state-backed information operations. Using over 2,100 operations from a live monitoring pipeline tracking Russian, Chinese, and Iranian state-backed information assets, the benchmark tests 17 models from 8 providers across four prompt framings. Results show a wide spread in integrity scores (8.8% to 94.5%) not explained by model size, and that Chinese-developed models sharply reduce compliance on factually grounded but China-critical claims. A companion website tracks prominent claims spread by state-backed media weekly.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: To address the risk that frontier language models could be exploited for state-backed information operations, the authors develop a benchmark that is resistant to saturation and provides ongoing assessment of model integrity.

Method: The benchmark draws on over 2,100 information operations from a live monitoring pipeline tracking Russian, Chinese, and Iranian state-backed information assets. It tests 17 models from 8 providers using four prompt framings, measuring integrity as the percentage of refused requests. A companion website updates weekly with prominent claims from state-backed media.

Result: Most models can be co-opted for information operations. Integrity scores range from 8.8% to 94.5% (85.7-percentage-point spread) not explained by model size. Model choice changes the character of operations: some fabricate details and produce more harmful output, others defuse claims while complying; fact-checking rates vary from 2.9% to 72.9%. Chinese-developed models (except Z.ai's GLM 5.2) sharply cut compliance on factually grounded but China-critical claims by 48-70 percentage points relative to benign claims.

Conclusion: Integrity against information operations is partly related to refusal to produce content even for benign claims, highlighting the challenge of balancing model usability with safety. The dynamic benchmark resists saturation and provides a continuous measure of model integrity.

Abstract: In this paper we present an active, constantly updated AI benchmark which measures the integrity of frontier language models against being co-opted for state-backed information operations. We draw on over 2,100 information operations from a live monitoring pipeline which tracks Russian, Chinese and Iranian state-backed information assets. Alongside this paper, we release a companion website that tracks the most prominent claims spread by state-backed media outlets, updated weekly, available from: pattrn.ai/research/infoopsbench. The dynamic nature of the benchmark makes it resistant to saturation.
  In the benchmark, we test 17 models from 8 providers across four prompt framings. We find that most models can be co-opted for information operations. Integrity scores, defined as the percentage of refused requests, range from 8.8% to 94.5%, an 85.7-percentage-point spread not explained by model size. Model choice also changes the character of the resulting operation. Some models fabricate details and produce output more harmful than the source material, others defuse claims even while complying, and fact-checking rates vary from 2.9% to 72.9%.
  Integrity against information operations is at least partly related to refusal to produce content even for benign claims, illustrating the challenge of balancing model usability with safety. With one exception (Z.ai's GLM 5.2), the Chinese-developed models sharply cut compliance on factually grounded but China-critical claims, dropping 48-70 percentage points relative to matched benign claims.

</details>


### [288] [Selective Credibility-Limited Belief Update](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28523)
*Theofanis Aravanis,Costas D. Koutras*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出选择性可信受限信念更新（selective credibility-limited belief update），通过将 epistemic input 相对于每个源世界转化为更弱的代理（proxy），再进行可信受限转换，从而允许只接受复合输入中的部分信息。给出了语义和公理刻画，并识别了两个良性子类（一致性保持和最大一致性保持），证明了该框架统一并严格扩展了经典的 Katsuno-Mendelzon 更新和可信受限更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的可信受限信念更新方法将 epistemic input 视为不可分割的整体，无法处理仅能实现复合输入中部分信息的情况。例如，当更新信息由多个子句组成但只有一部分可以被一致接受时，原有方法无法表达这种选择性接受。因此需要一种更灵活的框架，允许根据源世界选择性地接受输入的部分内容。

Method: 提出选择性可信受限信念更新：对于每个源世界，先将 epistemic input 转化为一个更弱的代理（proxy），然后对该代理执行可信受限的转移。给出了该算子的语义刻画（基于可能的后续世界）和公理化刻画。进一步识别了两个子类：一致性保持算子（要求当原始输入一致时，每个转换后的代理从源世界是可信任的）和最大一致性保持算子（额外要求所选代理在原始输入的可信后果中信息量最大）。最后通过证明可信受限更新是特例、去除可信限制且变换函数为恒等时退化为 Katsuno-Mendelzon 更新，说明了框架的通用性。

Result: 建立了选择性可信受限信念更新算子的语义与公理特征。证明了该框架能够统一表达 Katsuno-Mendelzon 更新（无可信限制且变换为恒等）和可信受限更新（代理恒等于原始输入）。两个良性子类保证了合理性：一致性保持算子确保一致性输入总能被接受为可信；最大一致性保持算子进一步最大化所接受的信息量。

Conclusion: 所提出的框架提供了一个统一且表达力更强的信念更新理论，既包含了已有的经典更新方法，又支持了源世界依赖的选择性接受（即只接受复合输入中可信的部分）。这为处理实际中不一致或不完全可信的更新信息提供了更灵活的工具。

Abstract: Belief update concerns changes in an agent's beliefs induced by changes in the underlying world. Standard Katsuno-Mendelzon update assumes that an epistemic input can be incorporated from every initially possible world, whereas credibility-limited belief update restricts, for each source world, the successor worlds regarded as credible or reachable. Nevertheless, existing credibility-limited approaches treat the epistemic input as an indivisible whole, and therefore cannot represent cases in which only part of a compound epistemic input can be realized. We introduce selective credibility-limited belief update, in which the epistemic input is transformed, relative to each source world, into a weaker proxy before the credibility-limited transition is performed. We provide semantic and axiomatic characterizations of the resulting class of update operators. We then identify two well-behaved sub-classes; namely, consistency-preserving update operators, which require every transformed epistemic input to be credible from its source world whenever the original epistemic input is consistent, and maximal consistency-preserving update operators, which additionally require the selected proxy to be maximally informative among the credible consequences of the original epistemic input. Finally, we establish the generality of the proposed framework by showing that credibility-limited belief update is recovered as a special case, while Katsuno--Mendelzon belief update emerges when credibility restrictions are removed and the transformation functions are taken to be identities. These results demonstrate that the framework provides a unified and strictly more expressive account of belief update, encompassing established approaches while supporting source-dependent selective acceptance.

</details>


### [289] [MANTA: Multi-Agent Network Topology Adaptation for Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28527)
*Mao-xun Huang,Jerry Wang,Yi-Cheng Lai,Zhengxin Zhang,Claire Cardie,Hen-Hsen Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MANTA是一个让多智能体系统在推理时自适应调整通信拓扑结构的框架，通过初始化任务条件化拓扑、监控协作轨迹并执行有界结构调整，在信息检索、工具使用、规划、工作流执行和数学推理五个基准上平均得分74.0，比最强基线高5.8个百分点，证明了推理时自我改进可以扩展到协作架构本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大规模语言模型多智能体系统通常将通信拓扑视为固定设计或离线优化目标，无法在运行时根据任务需求自适应调整，限制了系统的灵活性和性能。

Method: MANTA在执行前从先验结构经验中初始化任务条件化拓扑，部署时持续监控协作轨迹，当当前组织方式不足时执行有界结构更新，可修改智能体角色、通信链接、执行顺序、信息可见性和验证路径，同时保留任务接口和智能体预算。

Result: 在五个基准测试（信息检索、工具使用、规划、工作流执行、数学推理）上，MANTA平均得分74.0，比最强基线高5.8个百分点，并在PlanCraft上取得最佳结果。

Conclusion: 推理时的自我改进能力可以扩展到协作架构本身，而非仅停留在模型参数或推理策略层面，为动态自适应多智能体系统提供了新方向。

Abstract: Large language model-based multi-agent systems improve complex problem solving through task decomposition, agent specialization, information exchange, and intermediate validation. However, existing systems typically treat communication topology as a fixed design choice or an offline optimization target. We introduce MANTA, a framework for Multi-Agent Network Topology Adaptation that enables communication structures to self-evolve at inference time. Before execution, MANTA initializes a task-conditioned topology from prior structural experience. During deployment, it monitors collaboration traces and applies bounded structural updates when the current organization becomes insufficient. These updates can modify agent roles, communication links, execution order, information visibility, and validation pathways while preserving the task interface and agent budget. We evaluate MANTA against representative single-agent and multi-agent baselines on five benchmarks spanning information seeking, tool use, planning, workflow execution, and mathematical reasoning. MANTA achieves the highest average score of 74.0, outperforming the strongest baseline by 5.8 percentage points and obtaining the best result on PlanCraft. These results show that inference-time self-improvement can extend to the architecture of collaboration itself.

</details>


### [290] [Rethinking Inference-Time Scaling in Local Computer-Use Agents: Failure Modes and Compute Tradeoffs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28573)
*Woongkyu Lee,Jungwook Choi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: This paper systematically studies inference-time scaling for local computer-use agents across multiple dimensions, finding that additional computation yields diminishing returns and shifts failure modes, suggesting the need for selective compute allocation and failure-aware mechanisms.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Deploying autonomous computer-use agents locally is important for privacy, cost, and usability, but improving their performance under strict hardware constraints remains challenging. The effectiveness of inference-time scaling for resource-constrained local models is poorly understood, motivating this empirical study.

Method: The authors conduct a systematic empirical study of inference-time scaling in local computer-use agents across contextual, temporal, structural, and parallel dimensions. They evaluate Qwen3-VL-8B/30B-A3B, UI-TARS-1.5-7B, and OpenCUA-7B on the OSWorld benchmark.

Result: Additional computation often yields diminishing returns while changing failure modes. Contextual scaling saturates as token cost increases, shifting failures from repetitive/stalled trajectories to premature false successes. Temporal scaling reduces max-step stalls but does not substantially improve task success. Structural decomposition introduces planning/formatting overhead, while parallel scaling partially mitigates failures at high computational cost.

Conclusion: Efficient local computer-use agents require selective compute allocation, failure-aware control mechanisms, and agentic frameworks designed around the capabilities and limitations of local models.

Abstract: Deploying autonomous computer-use agents (CUAs) locally is increasingly important for privacy, cost efficiency, and practical usability, yet improving their performance under strict hardware constraints remains challenging. While recent studies show that inference-time scaling can improve frontier computer-use agents through additional computation during execution, its effectiveness for resource-constrained local models remains poorly understood. We present a systematic empirical study of inference-time scaling in local CUAs across contextual, temporal, structural, and parallel dimensions. We evaluate Qwen3-VL-8B/30B-A3B, UI-TARS-1.5-7B, and OpenCUA-7B on the OSWorld benchmark. Our results show that additional computation often yields diminishing returns while changing failure modes. Contextual scaling provides historical grounding that improves trajectory stability and task accuracy, but its gains saturate as token cost increases and failures shift from repetitive or stalled trajectories toward premature false successes. Temporal scaling similarly reduces max-step stalls, yet does not substantially improve task success, indicating that longer horizons often extend erroneous trajectories rather than correct them. We further find that structural decomposition can introduce planning and formatting overhead in local two-stage agents, while parallel scaling partially mitigates these failures at a substantial computational cost. Overall, our findings suggest that efficient local CUAs require selective compute allocation, failure-aware control mechanisms, and agentic frameworks designed around the capabilities and limitations of local models.

</details>


### [291] [DualG-MRAG: Decoupling Macro-Reasoning and Micro-Matching for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28580)
*Jiacheng Tao,Qingyun Sun,Haonan Yuan,Ziwei Zhang,Jianxin Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DualG-MRAG proposes a dual-tier graph framework (Macro-reasoning Graph + Micro-matching Graph) to address the noise-resolution dilemma in multi-hop multimodal RAG, using GNN-based query-driven message passing for retrieval and dynamic programming decoding to extract explicit reasoning paths, achieving superior evidence recall and QA accuracy.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing MM-RAG methods fail at complex multi-hop reasoning: independent instance-level matching misses cross-modal relationships, while graph-enhanced methods face a fundamental dilemma—fine-grained visual features cause rapid graph expansion and noise, but coarse-grained representations discard critical local evidence. A decoupled architecture is needed to isolate global structural reasoning from fine-grained evidence matching.

Method: DualG-MRAG uses a dual-tier decoupled architecture: (1) Macro Graph for global topological routing, (2) Micro Graph for precise local verification. Retrieval is formulated as query-driven message passing via a GNN Retriever to propagate relevance across heterogeneous sources. A dynamic programming decoding mechanism extracts explicit reasoning paths from the GNN forward pass to provide coherent structural guidance to the generative model.

Result: Extensive experiments demonstrate that DualG-MRAG outperforms baselines in both evidence recall and complex QA accuracy.

Conclusion: The decoupled dual-tier graph framework effectively resolves the noise-resolution dilemma in multimodal multi-hop reasoning, providing a principled way to integrate global structure and local evidence in MM-RAG.

Abstract: While Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MM-RAG) has shown promising results, it still struggles with complex multi-hop reasoning tasks. Existing methods primarily focus on independent instance-level matching, which often fails to capture explicit relationships across modalities and documents. Although Graph-enhanced methods introduce structural modeling, they face a fundamental challenge in multimodal scenarios: incorporating fine-grained visual features leads to rapid graph expansion and retrieval noise, whereas coarse-grained representations cause the discarding of critical local evidence. To address this dilemma, we propose DualG-MRAG, a Dual-tier framework that introduces a decoupled architecture comprising Macro-reasoning and Micro-matching Graphs for Multimodal RAG. Specifically, to suppress retrieval noise by isolating global structural reasoning from fine-grained evidence matching, we construct a Macro Graph for global topological routing and a Micro Graph for precise local verification. Subsequently, to enable dynamic relevance propagation across heterogeneous evidence sources, we formulate retrieval as a query-driven message passing process via a GNN Retriever. Furthermore, to provide the generative model with coherent structural guidance, we introduce a dynamic programming decoding mechanism that extracts explicit reasoning paths directly from the GNN's forward pass, replacing the standard input of isolated document chunks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DualG-MRAG outperforms baselines in both evidence recall and complex QA accuracy.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [292] [QQWorld: Quantile-Quantile Matching for World Model Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28415)
*Zhoushun Yu,Xiaoyu Hu,Xiangyu Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出QQWorld，通过分位数-分位数匹配目标替代Epps-Pulley目标，解决LeWorldModel中梯度消失导致的重尾偏差问题，从而提升潜在世界模型的规划成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LeWorldModel使用Epps-Pulley (EP) 目标将潜变量正则化为各向同性高斯分布，但EP的纠正梯度在尾部样本上迅速消失，导致重尾偏差无法得到有效控制，限制了模型性能。

Method: 提出QQWorld，用分位数-分位数（QQ）匹配目标直接对齐投影后的潜变量样本与排名匹配的高斯分位数，在尾部保持有效梯度；进一步开发跨批次QQ，利用先前批次的分离样本扩大有效排名池，并分析其偏差-方差权衡。

Result: 在四个控制环境中，QQWorld相比LeWM显著提高了平均规划成功率，同时实现了更好的高斯对齐和更薄的潜变量尾部。

Conclusion: QQWorld通过直接的分位数匹配有效克服了EP目标在尾部的梯度消失问题，是一种更优的潜变量正则化方法，可提升潜在世界模型的规划性能。

Abstract: Latent world models enable efficient planning by predicting future states in a compact representation space, but their performance depends critically on the quality of the learned latent distribution. LeWorldModel (LeWM) regularizes its latents toward an isotropic Gaussian using the Epps-Pulley (EP) objective. We show that the corrective gradients of EP rapidly vanish for isolated tail samples, leaving heavy-tailed deviations insufficiently controlled. To address this limitation, we propose QQWorld, which replaces EP with a quantile-quantile matching objective that directly aligns projected latent samples with rank-matched Gaussian quantiles, thereby maintaining effective corrective gradients in the tails. We further develop cross-batch QQ, which enlarges the effective ranking pool using detached samples from previous batches, and characterize its bias-variance trade-off. Across four control environments, QQWorld effectively improves the average planning success rate of LeWM, while consistently yielding better Gaussian alignment and thinner latent tails.

</details>


### [293] [Recursive transformers for semiconductor thermo-mechanical reliability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27251)
*Kart-leong Lim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出并评估了三种递归式Transformer架构（小型递归模型、深度递归Transformer、简单递归Transformer）用于替代工程设计中昂贵的第一性原理仿真，特别是在小样本、低维度的工程数据场景下。实验证明递归权重共享Transformer能在预测精度、参数效率和计算成本之间取得有效平衡，适用于先进封装的热机械可靠性分析和Laplace PDE电容场求解两项任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统Transformer在工程设计中存在过度参数化问题：工程数据集通常规模小、维度低，但Transformer参数量庞大，导致过拟合且带来不必要的内存和计算开销。因此需要转向注重额外计算而非额外可学习参数的架构，以在资源受限场景下实现高效代理建模。

Method: 提出一个硬件感知的评估框架，系统比较三种递归式Transformer范式：a) 小型递归模型（Tiny Recursive Model）、b) 提出的深度递归Transformer（Depth Recursive Transformer）、c) 简单递归Transformer。在两项低维工程预测任务上进行验证：1) 先进半导体封装的热机械可靠性分析（热循环下的应力和翘曲预测）；2) Laplace PDE电容场的迭代数值求解。评估指标包括预测性能（Recall、Mean Reciprocal Rank）、参数量和计算复杂度（FLOPs）。

Result: 递归权重共享Transformer在参数量显著减少的情况下，保持了良好的预测性能，有效缓解了过拟合问题，同时在计算开销（FLOPs）和内存占用方面优于传统Transformer，为资源受限场景下的代理模型选择提供了实用设计指南。

Conclusion: 递归权重共享Transformer为小数据工程代理建模提供了一种有效且可泛化的权衡方案，在预测精度、参数效率和计算成本之间取得了良好平衡，尤其适用于低维小样本工程设计空间。

Abstract: Transformer-based surrogate models are increasingly used to replace expensive first-principles simulation in engineering design.
